description:
Hi! I’m a Biomedical Engineering student passionate about science communication, space and storytelling. We’re tackling the NASA Storytelling challenge to turn complex space data into engaging narratives.

Looking for:

• Writers & Content Creators

• UI/UX & Graphic Designers

• Web Developers
summary:
THE LAST SIGNAL is an interactive educational narrative game inspired by NASA’s Mars Exploration Rover Opportunity. Through three acts, players uncover the rover’s story by collecting scattered components, rebuilding it, and exploring the Martian landscape. Along the way, they discover scientific findings, including hematite-rich “blueberries,” which revealed evidence of Mars’ watery past.

The project transforms the history of a retired space exploration artifact into an engaging educational experience, making NASA’s scientific legacy accessible to younger audiences through interactive storytelling rather than traditional learning methods.

By imagining an alternative ending where Opportunity’s signal is restored, THE LAST SIGNAL highlights the longevity of space technology, the importance of preserving scientific heritage, and the potential value of completed missions. Ultimately, it inspires a new generation to explore space while ensuring that the stories of past missions are never forgotten.
details:
🎮 Project Details

THE LAST SIGNAL is an interactive educational game inspired by NASA’s Mars Exploration Rover Opportunity. Through three acts — Discover, Rebuild, and Explore — players recover lost rover components, reconstruct Opportunity, and journey across Mars while encountering scientific discoveries and environmental challenges.

The project transforms the legacy of a retired spacecraft into an engaging learning experience for students, young audiences, and space enthusiasts.


💻 Tech Stack

  • HTML5 — Game structure and interface.
  • JavaScript — Game logic, interactive mechanics, and player interactions.
  • Custom Visual Assets — Original illustrations, rover components, and Martian environments.
  • GitHub Pages — Web hosting and deployment.
  • NASA Resources — Scientific research and educational content.

✨ Innovation Highlights

  • Interactive Storytelling: Players actively participate in Opportunity’s imagined second journey.
  • Educational Gameplay: Rover reconstruction and Martian exploration introduce robotics and planetary science.
  • Scientific Foundation: NASA’s Opportunity findings, including hematite “blueberries,” inform the educational content.
  • Emotional Engagement: A fictional restored signal symbolizes the enduring legacy of space exploration.
  • Accessibility: The game can be accessed through a web browser.

🎯 Intended Impact

THE LAST SIGNAL aims to inspire curiosity about space exploration, introduce younger audiences to STEM concepts, and demonstrate how completed missions can continue educating future generations.
